cases.sentence: Сыновья Аарона, Надав и Авиуд, взяли каждый свою ___, положили в них тлеющие угли, добавили благовоний.
cases.translation: The sons of Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, each took his censer, put fire in it, and added incense.
cases.explain: Кадильницу (censer) is the direct object of the verb взяли (took), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он привел молодого ___ для жертвы за грех, а Аарон и его сыновья возложили руки ему на голову.
cases.translation: He brought a young bull for a sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
cases.explain: Быка (bull) is the direct object of привел (brought), taking the accusative case, which equals genitive for animate masculine nouns.

cases.sentence: Они подошли, взяв их за халаты, вынесли их за ___, как приказал Моисей.
cases.translation: So they came near, and carried them in their tunics out of the camp, as Moses had said.
cases.explain: Лагерь (camp) is the direct object following the preposition за (beyond), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Господь сказал Аарону, «Ты и твои сыновья не должны пить вино или другие крепкие напитки, когда входите в ___ собрания».
cases.translation: The Lord said to Aaron, "You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die."
cases.explain: Шатер (tent) is the direct object after the preposition в (into), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Не уходите от входа в шатер собрания, иначе вы умрете, ведь на вас Господне ___.
cases.translation: Do not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting, lest you die; for the anointing oil of the Lord is on you.
cases.explain: Помазание (anointing) is the subject of the verb есть (is), taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Моисей сказал Аарону и его сыновьям Элиазару и Тамару, «Не оплакивайте их, распуская волосы и разрывая на себе одежду, иначе вы умрете, а Господь разгневается на весь ___».
cases.translation: Moses said to Aaron and his sons Eleazar and Ithamar, "Do not let your hair go loose and do not tear your clothes, lest you die and He be angry with all the congregation."
cases.explain: Народ (people) is the direct object of the preposition на (against), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Возьмите хлебное приношение, которое осталось из огненных жертв Господу, и ешьте его, приготовленное без закваски, возле ___.
cases.translation: Take the grain offering that remains from the offerings made to the Lord by fire, and eat it unleavened beside the altar.
cases.explain: The preposition возле (beside) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: When Moses heard that, it was pleasing in his sight.
cases.explain: In past tense, the verb согласиться agrees with the subject Моисей (masculine singular), taking the masculine form согласился.

reading.ru: Сыновья Аарона, Надав и Авиуд, взяли каждый свою кадильницу, положили в них тлеющие угли, добавили благовоний и принесли Господу чуждый огонь, чего он им не велел.
reading.question: What did Nadab and Abihu do that was forbidden?
options: They offered strange fire that He had not commanded
They ate food without washing their hands
They entered the Holy of Holies
They refused to wear their priestly garments
reading.correct: They offered strange fire that He had not commanded
reading.explain: The text states они принесли Господу чуждый огонь, чего он им не велел — they offered strange fire that He had not commanded.

reading.ru: От Господа вышел огонь, который сжег их, и они погибли перед Господом.
reading.question: What happened as a result of their offering?
options: Fire from the Lord consumed them and they died
They were sent into the wilderness
reading.correct: Fire from the Lord consumed them and they died
reading.explain: The text says От Господа вышел огонь, который сжег их, и они погибли перед Господом — Fire came out from the Lord and consumed them, and they died.

reading.ru: Тогда Моисей сказал Аарону, «Это то, о чем Господь говорил, среди приближающихся ко мне я явлю свою святость».
reading.question: How did Moses explain what happened to Aaron?
options: God would show His holiness to those who approach Him
God was angry with Aaron personally
The sacrifice was not prepared correctly
The tent was not built properly
reading.correct: God would show His holiness to those who approach Him
reading.explain: Moses quoted the Lord saying среди приближающихся ко мне я явлю свою святость — among those who come near Me I will show My holiness.

reading.ru: Это вечное установление для грядущих поколений.
reading.question: Was this rule only for Aaron's time or for future generations?
options: For future generations - an eternal statute
Only for Aaron and his immediate family
reading.correct: For future generations - an eternal statute
reading.explain: The text explicitly states Это вечное установление для грядущих поколений — This is an eternal statute for future generations.

reading.ru: Ты и твои сыновья не должны пить вино или другие крепкие напитки, когда входите в шатер собрания, иначе вы умрете.
reading.question: What prohibition did the Lord give to Aaron regarding entering the Tent of Meeting?
options: Not to drink wine or strong drink when entering the Tent
Not to eat meat before entering
Not to speak to anyone outside the tent
reading.correct: Not to drink wine or strong drink when entering the Tent
reading.explain: The text clearly states Ты и твои сыновья не должны пить вино или другие крепкие напитки, когда входите в шатер собрания — You and your sons shall not drink wine or strong drink when you enter the Tent of Meeting.

reading.ru: Аарон ответил Моисею, «Сегодня они принесли жертву за грех и всесожжение Господу, и все же со мной случилось такое».
reading.question: What did Aaron say to explain his grief during these tragic events?
options: They had brought the sacrifices today yet this tragedy had befallen him
The sacrifices were not accepted by God
He wanted to become high priest alone
He blamed Nadab and Abihu for the problem
reading.correct: They had brought the sacrifices today yet this tragedy had befallen him
reading.explain: Aaron responded Сегодня они принесли жертву за грех и всесожжение Господу, и все же со мной случилось такое — Today they brought the sacrifices yet such a thing happened to me.
